description: Attested Windows/Linux upgrade matrix for the exact 2.0.0-preview.1 CLI and SDK tarballs produced by the release-evidence workflow. Historical producers, structural skips, F3 pins, state shapes, projection restoration, profile non-access, idempotency and unsupported-downgrade observations are inherited from upgrade-matrix.json; runs additionally pin targetSha, evidence run/artifact, both tarball sha256 values and the preview harnessHash.

concepts.upgrade: `squad upgrade` with the current CLI: refreshes Squad-owned files, migrates casting/state, preserves user state. The only supported direction.
concepts.projection uninstall: `uninstallClients()` from `@bradygaster/squad-sdk/client`: removes generated host projections and restores shared files byte-exact. Does not change the installed CLI, `.squad/` state, or the repository's Squad version.
concepts.unsupported downgrade: Running an older Squad CLI against an upgraded repository. Not supported; the `downgrade-probe` check only records what each old CLI does so users are warned (0.9.1 `--dry-run` mutates — F3).

producers.why: Oldest 0.x line that still installs on Node 22 (engines >=22.5); pinned with its own @bradygaster/squad-sdk@0.9.1 (its `>=0.9.0` range would otherwise float to 1.0.1). Scaffolds `.squad/` with an EMPTY `casting/` directory and skills under `.copilot/skills/`; predates --state-backend.
Last 0.x stable; first line with --state-backend (local|orphan|two-layer) and user-profile squads (writes teamRoot when a profile squad exists).
First 1.x stable; last version published to npm (dist-tag latest).
Patch release whose CLI never reached npm (release run 37222633918: SDK publish failed, CLI publish skipped); only the standalone bundles exist.

Latest 1.x release; npm CLI publish failed in release run 39442663504 ("Could not verify @bradygaster/squad-cli@1.1.0 on npm dist-tag 'latest' after 20 attempts"), so the standalone bundle is the only published artifact.
Same-version clean install and idempotency using the exact release-evidence CLI/SDK tarballs, not a repository rebuild.

artifacts.pack: Exact preview tarballs downloaded from the attested release-evidence workflow and verified by sha256.

shapes.default: `squad init` with an empty profile directory, plus a custom agent (`agents/probe/`), an appended decision, a hand-written `.mcp.json` server, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and a `.gitignore` rule.
shapes.profile: As `default`, but the platform config dir is pre-seeded with the 1.x user-profile layout (a roster directory and a `.squad/` under `<config>/squad/`); the whole tree must stay sha256-identical and the project must not be linked to it.
shapes.legacy-casting: As `default`, then `.squad/casting/` is replaced by a hand-written `registry.json` (`{universe, agents:[{name, role, status}]}`) with no history — the shape an agent-edited 1.x registry has.
shapes.orphan: `squad init --state-backend orphan` (producers that have the flag); the `squad-state` branch and `stateBackend` must survive.
shapes.two-layer: `squad init --state-backend two-layer` (producers that have the flag); the `squad-state` branch and `stateBackend` must survive.
shapes.ai-team: As `default`, then `.squad/` is renamed to the legacy `.ai-team/` and the upgrade runs with `--migrate-directory`.
shapes.upstream: HEAD only: a second squad is declared via `squad upstream add <path> --name org`; `upstream.json` must survive the upgrade byte-exact.

checks.target-tarballs-verified: The exact preview CLI and SDK tarballs match the workflow-supplied sha256 values before extraction or execution.
checks.target-version-smoke: The packed CLI reports exactly 2.0.0-preview.1 from `squad --version`, and both packed package manifests carry that version.
checks.target-exports-resolve: Every exact and wildcard `exports` target in both packed package manifests resolves to at least one file inside the extracted tarball.
checks.self-upgrade-resolution: The packed `selfUpgradeCommand` / injectable `selfUpgradeCli` resolve npm, pnpm and yarn to the exact latest/insider commands without executing a network install.
checks.producer-artifact-verified: The pinned artifact that was executed matched its recorded hashes (npm: sha1 shasum + sha512 integrity of both tarballs; GitHub Release: sha256 of the asset downloaded by id). A mismatch FAILS every row of that producer — it is never a skip; only an unreachable registry/release skips, with the reason.
checks.scenario-setup: The matrix could set up the shape (e.g. configure the `upstream` squad). Only recorded when setup fails: a row can never be `fail` without a failing check (LD-2).
checks.producer-init: The OLD CLI (the pinned producer artifact) scaffolds the project non-interactively (exit 0, `.squad/team.md` present).
checks.upgrade-plain: `squad upgrade` (plus `--migrate-directory` for `ai-team`) with the NEW packed CLI exits 0.
checks.coordinator-is-new-template: `.github/agents/squad.agent.md` carries the new version stamp (`<!-- version: X -->`, `Squad (vX)`).
checks.user-state-preserved: Full manifest compare (path + sha256 of every file outside `.git/`) before/after the plain upgrade: every seeded user file — active and retired agent folders, nested unknown files, filenames with spaces and Unicode, appended `decisions.md`/`team.md`/`routing.md`, a user skill — is byte-identical; every changed path matches a declared Squad-owned pattern (`squadOwned`); the custom `config.json` key is kept. For `orphan`/`two-layer` the mutable state (`decisions.md`, `agents/*/history.md`) is seeded as git blobs on `squad-state` and every seeded blob OID must be unchanged and no branch path deleted. For `ai-team` the legacy directory is mapped onto `.squad/` first so the migration itself is not counted.
checks.casting-pair-valid: `readCastingRegistryPair` from the packed SDK reads a numbered registry + history; for `legacy-casting` the hand-written original is archived and `probe` is in the repaired registry.
checks.state-backend-preserved: `config.json` `stateBackend` is unchanged; for `orphan`/`two-layer` the `squad-state` branch still exists.
checks.ai-team-migrated: `.ai-team/` is gone and `.squad/team.md` exists (only for the `ai-team` shape).
checks.team-root-absent: `config.json` has no `teamRoot` after the upgrade (Squad 2.0 never links a project to a profile directory).
checks.profile-untouched: The seeded 1.x `<config>/squad/` profile tree (roster directory + `.squad/`) is sha256-identical after EVERY phase (upgrade, second upgrade, downgrade probe, projection, doctor, uninstall — the offending phase is named) AND the fs access logger loaded into every Squad 2.0 process (`NODE_OPTIONS=--require test/fixtures/upgrade-matrix/fs-access-log.cjs`) recorded zero reads, probes or writes under it (only for `profile`).
checks.idempotent-second-upgrade: A second plain `squad upgrade` changes nothing: sha256 of every file outside `.git/`, every git ref OID (`for-each-ref`, incl. the `squad-state` branch and any notes refs), `git status --porcelain` and the `squad-state` commit count are identical.
checks.downgrade-probe: UNSUPPORTED PATH, recorded not endorsed: the OLD CLI's `upgrade --dry-run` against a copy of the upgraded project must modify nothing; its exit code and message are recorded as a note. Squad has no supported downgrade.
checks.clients-projected: `squad upgrade --client all --force` exits 0, `config.json` `clients` lists all 7 hosts, and every projection PARSES with its host's format — JSON (`.mcp.json`, `.kiro/agents/squad.json`, `.kiro/settings/mcp.json`, `opencode.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`), TOML (`.codex/agents/squad.toml`, `.codex/config.toml`), YAML frontmatter (`.github/agents/squad.agent.md`, `.claude/agents/squad.md`, `.kiro/steering/squad.md`, `.opencode/agent/squad.md`, `.cursor/agents/squad.md`, `.cursor/rules/squad.mdc`, `.agents/agents/squad.md`) — with a `squad_state` MCP entry where the host has one; mirrors the per-host assertions in `test/clients.test.ts`.
checks.user-config-preserved: After projection the user's `.mcp.json` server, `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` paragraphs and `.gitignore` rule are intact (for `upstream`: `upstream.json` is byte-identical).
checks.projection-uninstall-byte-exact: `uninstallClients(CLIENT_IDS)` from the packed SDK, judged against the tree right after the plain upgrade (before any projection): `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.gitignore` byte-identical to that baseline (absent stays absent); all 8 projection files removed (agents, Kiro steering, Cursor rules, Kiro agent JSON); `.mcp.json` equal to the baseline minus the `squad_state` entry Squad installed, with the user's server intact; Kiro/Cursor MCP JSON, `opencode.json` and `.codex/config.toml` created by the projection carry no `squad_state`; seeded `.squad/` files and `squad-state` blobs untouched. This is projection uninstall — NOT a package or repository rollback and NOT a downgrade.

findings.title: Stale `teamRoot` written by 0.13.x–1.x `init` survives `squad upgrade`; the upgraded project resolves in remote mode against the removed profile squad
repro: Seed a 1.x profile tree under the platform config dir: the user-profile roster directory and `.squad/` under `<config>/squad/` (APPDATA on Windows, XDG_CONFIG_HOME on Linux).

`squad init` with @bradygaster/squad-cli 0.13.1 or 1.0.0 (npm) or the 1.0.1 / 1.1.0 standalone bundle: it prints its profile-detected notice and writes `.squad/config.json` → `{ "version": 1, "teamRoot": "<config>\\squad" }`.
Upgrade with the 2.0 CLI packed from this tree: `squad upgrade` (exit 0, no warning about teamRoot).

`cat .squad/config.json` still contains `teamRoot: <config>/squad`; `squad doctor` reports `Mode: remote` and ❌ `routing.md`, `casting/registry.json`, `decisions.md` not found — it is reading `<config>/squad/.squad/`, not the project.
findings.observed: `team-root-absent` fails (`teamRoot=<config-home>/squad`) and `doctor` fails for the `profile` shape on every 0.13.1+ producer. The profile tree itself stays sha256-identical (`profile-untouched` passes), so this is a resolution defect, not a write: Squad 2.0 keeps honouring a link to a directory it no longer supports. Expected: `squad upgrade` drops (or refuses with guidance) a `teamRoot` that points at the platform config dir, and the project resolves in local mode.
findings.resolved: Fixed on squad2-c @ 21ecca77 (PR #2279): `squad upgrade` removes a `teamRoot` that resolves to the platform config dir / `~/.squad` / `SQUAD_HOME` (`isRetiredProfileTeamRoot()` in `@bradygaster/squad-sdk/resolution`) and prints `Removed stale teamRoot pointing to <path>; project state is now local`; `--dry-run` previews it; `resolveSquadPaths` treats such a teamRoot as local mode. Dual-root targets are untouched. Verified by this matrix: `team-root-absent` and `doctor` now pass for every 0.13.1+ producer × `profile` on both OSes (the former pins produced `xpass` before removal).

findings.title: `squad upgrade` never recognizes its own stamped coordinator: every run reports "local customizations" and overwrites `squad.agent.md.local-backup`
repro: `squad init` (any producer, including the 2.0 CLI itself), then `squad upgrade` once — a genuine pre-upgrade coordinator is saved to `.github/agents/squad.agent.md.local-backup`.
Run `squad upgrade` again with nothing changed.

Output again says `⚠️ squad.agent.md has local customizations — backed up to squad.agent.md.local-backup`; the backup is overwritten with the pristine current coordinator, so the user's real pre-upgrade copy is gone. The only file whose sha256 changes between run 1 and run 2 is `.github/agents/squad.agent.md.local-backup`.
findings.observed: `idempotent-second-upgrade` fails with exactly `.github/agents/squad.agent.md.local-backup` for every old producer × shape × platform. On a project initialized by the 2.0 CLI itself the warning is printed on every run too (`Already up to date` + `⚠️ … local customizations`), but the overwritten backup is byte-identical, so the HEAD rows are not pinned. Cause: `writeAgentTemplate` strips `<!-- squad-cli vX -->` before comparing, but `stampVersion` writes `<!-- version: X -->`, `- **Version:** X` and `Squad vX`, so a stamped coordinator never equals the template. Expected: a second `squad upgrade` is a byte-for-byte no-op, prints no customization warning, and never touches an existing `.local-backup`.
findings.resolved: Fixed on squad2-c @ 21ecca77 (PR #2279): `stripAgentStamps()` (`@bradygaster/squad-cli/core/upgrade`) normalizes `<!-- version: X -->`, the `- **Version:**` token, `` `Squad vX` ``, `@bradygaster/squad-cli@X` and the legacy `<!-- squad-cli vX -->` before the customization compare, and an identical `.local-backup` is not rewritten. Verified by this matrix: `idempotent-second-upgrade` now passes for every producer × shape on both OSes.

findings.title: Squad 0.9.1 `squad upgrade --dry-run` is not dry: pointed at a 2.0 project it silently downgrades the coordinator, skills, workflows and templates in place
findings.severity: info (historical producer defect — not fixable in 2.0; recorded for the downgrade story)
findings.layer: none — behavior of the published 0.9.1 CLI
repro: Scaffold with 0.9.1 (`npm install @bradygaster/squad-cli@0.9.1`), upgrade with the 2.0 CLI, copy the project.
In the copy run the 0.9.1 CLI: `squad upgrade --dry-run`.

It exits 0, prints the normal upgrade summary (`Upgrade complete: v1.2.0-preview.1 → v0.9.1 … Preserves user state: …`) and rewrites ~44 files with the pinned 0.9.1 SDK (~83 when 0.9.1's `>=0.9.0` SDK range floats to 1.0.1): `.github/agents/squad.agent.md` (back to 0.9.1), `.copilot/skills/*`, `.github/workflows/squad-*.yml`, `.squad/templates/*`, plus stray `.squad/charter.md`, `.squad/roster.md`, `.squad/history.md` … at the state root.
findings.observed: `downgrade-probe` fails for every 0.9.1 row because the dry-run modified files (destructive: it IS the downgrade) and printed `Upgrade complete: v1.2.0-preview.1 → v0.9.1`; 0.13.1, 1.0.0, 1.0.1 and 1.1.0 honor `--dry-run` (`Run without --dry-run to apply.`, nothing modified) but their preview lists `overwrite .github/workflows/squad-*.yml` etc. — none of the old CLIs has a newer-version guard, so running any of them for real against a 2.0 project downgrades the Squad-owned files. Guidance for users: never run an older CLI against an upgraded repository; re-run `squad upgrade` with the 2.0 CLI to repair a downgraded coordinator (team state is not touched by the downgrade).

findings.title: First `squad upgrade` of a 0.9.x project (empty `.squad/casting/`) does not converge: the coordinator's team-capabilities block is only rendered by the second upgrade
findings.layer: CLI core — `packages/squad-cli/src/cli/core/upgrade.ts` (coordinator write + `syncTeamCapabilities` run before the casting pair is scaffolded)
repro: `npx @bradygaster/squad-cli@0.9.1 init` with `@bradygaster/squad-sdk@0.9.1` pinned (the faithful 0.9.1 layout): `.squad/casting/` exists but contains no `registry.json`/`history.json`.

Run the 2.0 CLI `squad upgrade`: it prints `⚠️ Could not refresh squad.agent.md team capabilities: Cannot read a consistent casting registry/history pair: both files are required`, then creates the casting pair later in the same run.
Run `squad upgrade` again: `✓ upgraded squad.agent.md` — the coordinator gains the 17-line `<!-- squad:capabilities … -->` block that run 1 could not render. Nothing else changes.
findings.observed: `idempotent-second-upgrade` fails with exactly `.github/agents/squad.agent.md` for 0.9.1 × `default`/`profile`/`ai-team` on both OSes. 0.9.1 × `legacy-casting` is unaffected because the hand-written registry is repaired in the preflight, so the pair exists before the coordinator is written. The project is correct after the second run; the defect is ordering — the capabilities sync should run after the casting pair is ensured (or the pair should be ensured in the preflight).
findings.resolved: Fixed on squad2-c @ 50afa91a (PR #2279): `runUpgrade` runs `preflightCastingPair()` (ensureCastingDefaults) before `writeAgentTemplate` in both the already-current and the normal path, so a 0.9.x project with an empty `.squad/casting/` gets the `<!-- squad:capabilities -->` block on the first upgrade and the second upgrade is byte-identical (C test: `test/upgrade-profile-teamroot.test.ts` › "F4: a 0.9.x project (empty casting/) upgrades in ONE pass"). Verified by this matrix: with the pin still in place, `idempotent-second-upgrade` produced `xpass` on exactly 0.9.1 × default/profile/ai-team; the pin is removed.
